model_header:
10x5E                    (10x5E.dat)                                                                                                                                       
         v2022-0915                                                                                                                                                                 
         Simulation Date: 09/22/2022                                                                                                                                                
                                                                                                                                                                                    
         AIRFOIL AERO DATA GENERATED USING:  POLAR DIAGRAMS                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                                                    
         ====== PERFORMANCE DATA (versus advance ratio and MPH) ======                                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                    
         DEFINITIONS:                                                                                                                                                               
         J=V/nD (advance ratio)                                                                                                                                                     
         Ct=T/(rho * n**2 * D**4) (thrust coef.)                                                                                                                                    
         Cp=P/(rho * n**3 * D**5) (power coef.)                                                                                                                                     
         Pe=Ct*J/Cp (efficiency)                                                                                                                                                    
         V  (model speed in MPH)                                                                                                                                                    
         Mach (at prop tip)                                                                                                                                                         
         Reyn (at 75% of span)                                                                                                                                                      
         FOM (Figure of Merit)
limitations: UIUC geometry is approximate digitization of an off-the-shelf historical specimen; no exact airfoil/camber/sweep/thickness surface recovered.
Vendor file is a computational 2022 prediction, not a second wind-tunnel experiment; revision identity with historical specimen is not established.
Coefficient comparison is linear interpolation in RPM with no extrapolation or parameter fitting.
Measured free two-blade rotor data do not transfer to a high-solidity ducted rotor or vectoring vanes.
Vendor geometry archive download returned HTTP403; no complete 3D reproduction claimed.
